title: The Gift of Salvation
definition: The Gift of Salvation is the biblical truth that salvation is freely given by God's grace in Christ rather than earned by sinners.
summary: The Gift of Salvation emphasizes that eternal life and rescue in Christ are received by grace, not earned.
christFocus: Jesus Christ is God's unspeakable gift, given for sinners and received by faith.

studySections.heading: Doctrine in Summary
studySections.content: This doctrine presents salvation as God's generous gift rather than humanity's achievement. A gift must be received by faith, but it is not purchased by the receiver. It draws the believer into gratitude and strips away every attempt to boast before God.

studySections.heading: Why This Matters
studySections.content: This matters because fallen hearts constantly try to turn grace into wages. If salvation is gift, then the weakest sinner may come, and the strongest saint has no ground for pride. The Church must protect this grace from legalism and from entitlement.

studySections.heading: Discipleship and Application
studySections.content: Receive salvation with open-handed faith and humble thanks. Reject the instinct to prove that you are worthy of mercy. Give freely to others because you have received what you could never buy.
